summary: Created a 4-phase plan for the narrow catch-up sync of .opencode/scripts/command-gate-in.sh. The source-store file is already correct, so no source edit is planned; the fix is a verbatim cp from agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/command-gate-in.sh into the stale .opencode/ target. Pre-change test baselines were measured by execution during planning: source-store mode 36 passed / 1 failed with test-common-lib.sh PASSING, deployed mode 27 passed / 7 failed with test-common-lib.sh FAILING on the single offender .opencode/scripts/command-gate-in.sh. The plan's verification gate requires executed run-all.sh runs in both modes, with the deployed FAIL set losing exactly test-common-lib.sh and gaining nothing.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan: (1) capture pre-change run-all.sh baselines in both modes, (2) verbatim cp of the already-correct source file into .opencode/ with byte-identity, exec-bit, bash -n, and task-reference-lint verification, (3) full gate re-running both suites and diffing FAIL sets against the baseline, (4) record the manual-redeploy rationale and the two out-of-scope spawn candidates.

next_action_hint: Run /implement 1010. Phase 1 re-captures baselines before any edit; Phase 2 must use cp (not Write/Edit with retyped content) so byte-identity is guaranteed by the copy mechanism.

spawn_candidates: Add a headless (non-interactive) redeploy entrypoint for .opencode/, parallel to deploy-headless.sh's .claude/ support -- deploy-headless.sh hardcodes ext_config.claude() even though config.opencode() already exists in lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/config.lua. Without it, .opencode/ can only be redeployed via the interactive Neovim picker.

Resync the full .opencode/scripts/ tree from agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ -- 38 of 68 top-level scripts are missing, including task-lock.sh, verify-deploy.sh, state-write.sh, and the entire scripts/lib/ subdirectory, so other latent deployed-mode-only failures are likely.
Investigate the shared root cause of the five deployed-mode path-resolution test failures, which all compute the repo root as /home/benjamin rather than the actual repo root.
